status: MEASURED on the corrected instrument (task-6, plan 2.51); supersedes the retracted plan 2.42/2.46 numbers

design.phi: path J2 in nats = mean over slot tokens of [log p(slot+|x,y) - log p(slot-|x,y)] on the model's own continuation
design.normalisation: unified (task-3); every accumulation is a mean over rollouts AND contexts

baseline_comparison.note: the in-sample baseline b=mean(phi) yields E[(phi-b)s]=(1-1/K) g, so g_in underestimates g by that factor; the leave-one-out b_{-i} is unbiased

verdict: Three retracted numbers are replaced. (1) The score term is NOT 26.4x the pathwise term: it is 0.80x, i.e. the same order; the old ratio was a units artifact (last context only, double slot normalisation, 1/K vs 1/C). (2) The measure change costs cos 0.655, not 0.419, and the cost is layer-structured: 0.27 at layer 0 rising monotonically to 0.90 at layer 31, so teacher-forced gradients are a poor proxy mainly for EARLY layers. (3) The sample requirement is kappa ~ 217 rollouts per context for r=0.5 (curve-implied 217.5, inside the bootstrap interval [108.7,610.2]), not ~1500 and not the ambient dimension. The score term remains unusable at K=32 (r(32)=0.0685), which is a budget statement, not a closure of the estimator class.
baseline_reading: cos(LOO, in-sample) = 1.0000 exactly and |LOO|/|in-sample| = 1.0323 = 1/0.96875 = 1/(1-1/K): the in-sample baseline rotates the estimate not at all and biases only its magnitude, exactly by the predicted (1-1/K). The audit was right that the two baselines differ; they differ in scale only.
kappa_estimator_caveat: the pooled ANOVA point estimate (2100.6) falls OUTSIDE the context-bootstrap interval [108.7,610.2] while the curve-implied value sits inside it, so the pooled estimator is reported but not trusted (it mixes a global baseline with between-context variation). The audit section 4 objection is confirmed concretely.
